description: Start a full scan of a website: each page is requested separately as Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and CCBot, compared with a rendered browser view, and scored across six SEO, AEO and GEO categories, with technical health and Domain Rating. Uses the API key owner's plan quota. Returns a scan_id; then call get_scan with wait_seconds.
name: scan_site
title: Start an AI visibility scan
